The '''2026 Hull City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 19 of 57 members of [[Hull City Council]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Council |first=Hull City |title=Elections |url=https://www.hull.gov.uk/elections-voting/local-elections |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Hull |language=en}}</ref> The Liberal Democrats lost the council to [[no overall control]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-05-08 |title=Hull election result - Local Elections 2026 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2026/england/councils/E06000010 |access-date=2026-05-08 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Changes 2024–2026:
*June 2024: Gary Wareing (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Poxton |first1=Ivan |title=Councillor resigns Labour membership in protest over child benefit policy |url=https://www.hulldailymail.co.uk/news/hull-east-yorkshire-news/councillor-resigns-labour-membership-protest-9340521 |access-date=30 January 2026 |work=Hull Live |date=13 June 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*April 2025: Julia Conner (Liberal Democrats) and Sherilee Jepmond (Liberal Democrats) leave party to sit as independents<ref>{{cite news |last1=Spence |first1=Andrew |title=Two former Lib Dem councillors in Hull explain decision to become Independents |url=https://www.hulldailymail.co.uk/news/hull-east-yorkshire-news/two-former-lib-dem-councillors-10095204 |access-date=30 January 2026 |work=Hull Live |date=11 April 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*May 2025: Hester Bridges (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Spence |first1=Andrew |title=Senior Hull Labour councillor leaves party |url=https://www.hulldailymail.co.uk/news/hull-east-yorkshire-news/senior-hull-labour-councillor-leaves-10199804 |access-date=30 January 2026 |work=Hull Live |date=21 May 2025 |language=en}}</ref>
*September 2025: Peter North (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Spence |first1=Andrew |last2=Petrie |first2=Emma |title=Hull Labour councillor quits party to continue as independent |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cq5jjqezlwyo |access-date=30 January 2026 |work=BBC News |date=21 September 2025}}</ref>

==Summary==

===Background===
In [[2024 Hull City Council election|2024]], the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]] retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gerrard |first=Joseph |date=2024-05-03 |title=Hull local election results 2024 in full as Liberal Democrats retain control |url=https://www.hulldailymail.co.uk/news/hull-east-yorkshire-news/hull-city-council-local-election-9262252 |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Hull Live |language=en}}</ref>
